name: Reverso Translator
description: TMGMT translator plugin that sends content to the Reverso machine-translation API.
project_description:
The TMGMT Reverso Integration module allows seamless integration of the Reverso API with the TMGMT (Translation Management Tool) module in Drupal. This module enables automatic translation services powered by Reverso, facilitating efficient and accurate translation workflows directly within your Drupal site.

 With this integration, users can select Reverso as a translation provider in TMGMT, enabling the submission of content for translation with just a few clicks. The module supports various language pairs and leverages Reverso's advanced machine learning algorithms to deliver high-quality translations. Ideal for websites needing quick and reliable translations, this module simplifies the management of multilingual content.

 Key features: 
 Automatic Translation: Submit content for translation through TMGMT using the Reverso API.

 Language Support: Wide range of language pairs available for translation.

 Seamless Integration: Works directly with the TMGMT module for a unified translation experience.

 Customizable: Configure settings to match your specific translation needs.
